Our Services

Dependable Lift Servicing & Maintenance Throughout the North West

New Lift Installations

Our lift company specialises in the installation of all lifts. These include:

  • Passenger lifts
  • Goods lifts
  • Platform lifts and access lifts
  • Car lifts
  • Food lifts
  • Dumbwaiter lifts
More Information

Planned Maintenance & Servicing

Failure to keep up with regular maintenance not only involves an increased cost, it also compromises the reliability of the lift. To prevent this, our elevator company offers the following services:

  • Regular maintenance
  • Compliance with Health & Safety requirements
  • Advice and planning of future repairs
  • UK stock for replacement parts
More Information

Modernise Your Lifts

A modernisation can give just as good of a result as a new installation, for a more cost-effective price. If your lift is suitable for modernisation, the benefits include:

  • Reduced downtime
  • Improved appearance & image
  • Greater ride quality
  • Minimal disruption in the building
  • Reduced running costs
More Information

Breakdowns & Repairs

Breakdowns can be a real problem for everyone impacted. When choosing Altius Lifts for your lift needs, our lift company will do the following:

  • Conduct a free site survey
  • Issue a comprehensive report on our findings
  • Highlight any safety issues or components at risk
  • Provide an action plan for the best course of action
  • Complete the repairs to the highest standard
More Information

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our lift services.

We recommend that lifts are serviced at least every three months to ensure safe and reliable operation. Regular maintenance helps identify potential issues early, reducing the risk of costly breakdowns and ensuring compliance with safety regulations.

We install a wide range of lifts including passenger lifts, goods lifts, platform lifts, car lifts, food lifts, and dumbwaiter lifts. Each installation is tailored to the specific requirements of your building and usage needs.

The duration depends on the scope of the modernisation, but most projects are completed within two to four weeks. We work to minimise disruption to your building and its occupants throughout the process.

Yes, we provide a 24/7/365 emergency callout service across the North West. Our engineers are on hand to respond quickly to breakdowns and entrapments, ensuring minimal downtime and maximum safety for users.

We primarily serve Manchester and the wider North West region, including Stockport, Bolton, Salford, Oldham, and surrounding areas. Contact us to confirm whether we cover your location.

Absolutely. We offer a free, no-obligation site survey for all new enquiries. Our engineers will assess your requirements and provide a detailed report with recommendations and a transparent quotation.
